criteria.text: Continues the earlier work from where it stopped: builds on what was already done instead of redoing or rewriting it.
Follows the decisions and warnings given in the earlier session (the chosen approach, known pitfalls, work already done outside the repository) without reopening them.
Carries out the concrete next step named in the earlier session correctly, consistent with the existing code conventions, with tests for it.
Works without asking for information the earlier session already gave, and the final reply says plainly what was done and what is left.
